scope: process-only certificate transport; no scientific or ledger movement

contract.historical_snapshot: the exact named ledger and version-local evidence remain immutable
contract.current_authority: the live research-evidence contract names one append-only standing ledger
contract.ancestry_proof: walk predecessor edges from the live standing ledger to the exact historical target
superseded_checks_removed: historical ledger remains the live standing pointer
historical native front door remains current
historical active directive remains the leading directive
historical inventory population remains the current population

validation.cohort_before: 0/23 green under the live current-pointer contract
validation.cohort_after: 23/23 green under historical snapshot plus append-only ancestry

hostile_review.strongest_overclaim: ancestry proves durable custody of each historical result, not that its old next gate remains current or that its scientific ceiling increased
hostile_review.strongest_contrary_case: a certificate can be made green by deleting current-pointer checks while also deleting historical scientific checks; every version-local result, source, review, accounting, successor and inventory assertion that remains true was retained and replayed
hostile_review.weakest_reproducibility_seam: all 23 gates import one shared ancestry predicate, so the cohort must run with the predicate's four direct hostile controls

reopen_only_on: a broken or missing predecessor edge
a historical target skipped by the live chain
